title: Java fullstack developer (angular)
description:
About You
You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
Hands-on experience with Postgre SQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, and Bedrock.
Experience using My Batis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of Rx JS and Observables.
Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using Rx JS and Observables.
Implement and manage data persistence using Postgre SQL, My Batis, Liquibase, and Redis.
Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.
Qualifications
Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, Postgre SQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, Cloud Watch), Angular (v19 or similar), Rx JS / Observables, My Batis and Liquibase.
Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Operar e monitorar sistemas de comunicação marítima (VHF/UHF, satélite, telefonia IP) entre plataforma, embarcações de apoio, helicópteros e bases em terra.

Ensino médio completo (desejável formação técnica ou superior).
Experiência mínima de 2 anos como Radio Operador em ambiente offshore.
Conhecimento prático de sistemas de comunicação marítima e aeronáutica.
Familiaridade com normas internacionais de segurança offshore (IMO, SOLAS, API RP 75).
Inglês avançado
Português fluente. CERTIFICAÇÕ ES DESEJÁ VEIS:
Certificação de Radio Operador homologada pela Marinha do Brasil.
Certificação de Segurança Offshore (CBSP, HUET, NR-34, NR-37).
Livreto de Mar válido. CONDIÇÕ ES ESPECIAIS:
Contrato temporário com possibilidade de extensão conforme desempenho e demanda do projeto.

5+ years of experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud.
Strong experience with AWS infrastructure (ECS and container services).
Experience with Docker, Cloud Watch, and Datadog.
Conversational English (B2+).

title: Analista de validação de processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.

4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.
5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.
6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.
7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.
9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.
10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

title: Billing analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2 B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.
Key Responsibilities
Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2 C) processes.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
Professional proficiency in English.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability.
Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote Dev Ops culture, automation, and continuous improvement.

title: Nurse offshore
description:
Position: Nurse Offshore
Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Offshore Nurse is responsible for leading onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness, providing medical assistance, and promoting a healthy working environment and overall wellbeing for all personnel onboard the FPSO. The role also ensures compliance with corporate health standards and applicable regulations.
Key Responsibilities
Lead onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness and proper medical assistance at all times;
Activate MEDEVAC procedures in accordance with remote medical support instructions;
Maintain updated inventory of medicines and medical supplies, ensuring availability and preventing expired items onboard;
Liaise with onshore remote medical support for diagnosis guidance and prescription of medicines for injured or ill personnel;
Support the preparation and implementation of rescue plans (confined space and working at height);
Request calibration, hydrostatic testing, and replacement of hospital equipment and first aid kits to ensure prompt emergency response;
Inspect catering services and facilities, including food storage, conservation, preparation, and accommodation cleanliness, maintaining proper health inspection records;
Participate in auditing and certification processes related to health services;
Collect and monitor fresh and potable water samples, conducting analysis onboard and coordinating onshore testing in accordance with procedures;
Provide First Aid training to designated first aid teams onboard;
Prepare and maintain medical documentation and reports (Health Initial Report, Logbook, corporate reports, and other required documents);
Implement and maintain the Health Service Waste Management Program and ensure proper recordkeeping.
Requirements
Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;
Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Advanced life support and emergency care training;
Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;
Knowledge of Brazilian maritime and health regulations is an advantage.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Analista de seguros júnior -vaga exclusiva para pcd
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Atividades:

Realizar atendimentos aos clientes, respondendo a dúvidas, fornecendo informações e auxiliando em suas necessidades.
Verificar a conformidade dos processos de atendimento de acordo com as diretrizes e padrões estabelecidos.
Auxiliar na identificação de melhorias com base nos registros de atendimentos.
Colaborar com as equipes de atendimento e outras áreas para resolver problemas.
Acompanhar métricas e elaborar relatórios e apresentações.
Prestar suporte em cotações de seguros.
Controlar e resolver pendências de propostas e apólices de seguros.
Monitorar a regulação de sinistros.
Atualizar sistemas internos e planilhas de controle.

Ensino Superior completo.
Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel.
Excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita.
Proatividade, com capacidade de antecipar etapas e considerar possíveis desdobramentos.
Experiência no mercado de seguros.
Experiência com atendimento ao cliente e atividades administrativas.

Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
Vale Transporte/Estacionamento;

Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de vida;

title: Analista customer service
description:
Sobre a empresa: Grande Porte no segmento de materiais de construção.
O que você irá fazer:
Gestão ponta a ponta do ciclo do pedido, desde a entrada até faturamento e entrega, com análise crítica e lançamento de pedidos complexos no SAP.
Acompanhamento e análise de indicadores de Customer Service e Supply Chain (OTIF, On Time Delivery, Lean Rate, tempo de atendimento e resolução de problemas), com elaboração de relatórios e dashboards em Excel avançado, Tableau e Power BI.
Atuação em governança de performance, promovendo análises comparativas, identificação de gaps e discussões estratégicas para melhoria contínua.
Participação em projetos cross funcionais (ex.: Knauf Order, transporte e capacidade), atuando de forma integrada com PCP, Compras, Logística, Comercial, Financeiro e Transporte.
Atendimento multicanal (Whats App, e-mail e telefone) e interface com diferentes perfis de clientes, negociando indicadores e alinhando expectativas.
Atuação como referência técnica da área, com liderança indireta, apoio ao desenvolvimento do time júnior e disseminação de boas práticas orientadas a dados.

Forte foco no cliente e visão de impacto no negócio;
Maturidade profissional (postura ética, positiva, sem envolvimento em conflitos improdutivos);
Perfil analítico, organizado e estruturado;
Proatividade, dinamismo e senso de responsabilidade;
Capacidade de influenciar sem cargo formal de liderança.

Ensino Superior completo administração, comercial ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência em Customer Service e Comercial Interno ;
Vivência comprovada com gestão de pedidos complexos em SAP;
Forte atuação com indicadores de Supply Chain;
Excel avançado (obrigatório);
Inglês Avançado;
Capacidade de lidar com alto volume de informações e demandas simultâneas.

Seguro de vida
Wellhub

title: Operational excellence associate
description:
Position Summary
A critical aspect of Oceaneering’s culture is the desire to create value, speed, and agility in the manner in which we service customers and internal stakeholders. The Operational Excellence Associate is responsible for supporting business partners with the development, implementation and ongoing management of their long-term strategy and objectives and execution on Operational Excellence projects.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
In conjunction with the Operational Excellence Master or Practitioner, provide diagnostics of the business group or function throughout the year to identify potential Operational Excellence projects
Using Lean, DMAIC or other improvement methodologies, identify critical processes and controls necessary to meet business objectives
Implement and drive continuous improvement within the business group or function
Provide hands on utilization, implementation of Operational Excellence tools and concepts to identify areas for improvement that can accelerate business results, reduce COPQ and improve execution
Support or oversee the preparation and facilitation of Kaizen events
Assess, improve and develop the Operational Excellence knowledge, skills and abilities of the business group or function so they can incorporate Operational Excellence principles, concepts, and tools into their day to day activities and processes
Maintain KPIs for quality, productivity costs, and service delivery such as first-time quality, on time delivery, or efficiency improvements
Participate in or support high-profile – high-visibility projects using LSS, Agile, and/or project management methodologies
Qualifications:
Must be Fluent in English
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, Finance, Accounting, or equivalent
Experience in process improvement and project leadership such as the following:
Lean Six Sigma applications, to process redesign and improvement
Awareness or experience in Operational Excellence principles and practices including project management and agile methodologies
Ability and desire to achieve Green Belt to Lean Bronze certification
Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.
This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

description:
En Iquall Networks somos una empresa global que desarrolla soluciones de automatización para las redes de telecomunicaciones más importantes del mundo. Buscamos un/a Key Account Manager en Río de Janeiro, Brasil, con visión, energía y capacidad de ejecución para ayudarnos a seguir creciendo.

No importa si no tienes diez años de experiencia: lo que más valoramos es tu actitud, tu forma de pensar y tus ganas de marcar la diferencia. Eso sí, necesitamos que cuentes con experiencia previa en entornos comerciales o tecnológicos.

Ser el punto de contacto principal entre Iquall y los operadores de telecomunicaciones.
Acompañar el ciclo comercial completo: desde la detección y generación de oportunidades hasta el seguimiento postventa.
Participar activamente en la elaboración de propuestas, respuestas a RFPs y presentaciones de alto impacto.
Coordinar reuniones con distintas áreas del cliente (Tecnología, Operaciones, Compras, B2 B, etc.).
Construir relaciones de largo plazo, basadas en la confianza y un entendimiento profundo del negocio.
Identificar oportunidades de mejora y colaborar con nuestros equipos de producto, preventa y delivery.
Aportar ideas y opiniones sobre estrategia comercial y condiciones.
Qué buscamos en ti
Experiencia previa en áreas comerciales, técnicas o consultivas dentro del sector Telco o tecnológico.
Capacidad de autogestión y autonomía: aquí nadie te va a empujar; necesitamos que tomes la iniciativa.
Ganas de aprender rápido, colaborar intensamente y asumir retos variados.
Claridad para comunicar ideas complejas a distintos perfiles de interlocutores.
Espíritu colaborativo: no trabajas solo/a, trabajas con un equipo que te respalda.
Inglés imprescindible.
Buen criterio, inteligencia práctica y pasión por resolver problemas reales.

Formar parte de una empresa ágil, global y en pleno crecimiento.
Acceso a proyectos con los principales operadores del mercado.
Un entorno que valora las ideas nuevas, el compromiso y la capacidad de ejecución.
Modalidad 100% remota, con flexibilidad y autonomía.
Espacios reales para aprender, aportar y desarrollarte profesionalmente.
Si te ves reflejado/a en esta propuesta y quieres trabajar con impacto real en el futuro de las telecomunicaciones, escríbenos.
Queremos conocerte.

title: Estagiário de engenharia
description:
Sobre a DTXA DTX é uma empresa líder na indústria aeroespacial. Conhecida por sua abordagem inovadora e tecnologia de ponta, a empresa é especializada no design, fabricação e manutenção de trens de pouso. Com um forte foco em qualidade e segurança, estabelecemos-nos como um parceiro confiável para muitas das principais companhias aéreas e organizações militares em todo o mundo. Estamos comprometidos com a melhoria contínua e a sustentabilidade, investindo pesadamente em pesquisa e desenvolvimento para impulsionar a indústria.
Sobre o trabalho
Estamos buscando novos estagiários para compor nosso time de engenharia.
O foco deste programa de estágio é a formação técnica de futuros engenheiros especialistas em trem de pouso em processos de MRO.
O estagiário irá passar por todas as áreas do setor em esquema de \"job rotation\" para que possa aprender sobre o processo de trens de pouso de forma global.
1. Suporte de projeto e engenharia
Tarefas:
Apoiar os engenheiros na análise e revisão das especificações do projeto.
Auxiliar na avaliação de desenhos, esquemas e especificações para componentes do trem de pouso.
Saiber como as equipes de engenharia dão suporte ao processo de produção e manutenção.
Habilidades adquiridas:
Compreensão dos princípios de design para componentes aeroespaciais
Familiaridade com software CAD e desenhos de engenharia
Técnicas de resolução de problemas em engenharia aeroespacial
2. Análise de Tensão e Teste de Material
Tarefas de rotação:
Auxiliar em cálculos de análise de tensão ou simulações para componentes do trem de pouso.
Participar de testes de materiais, como testes de tração, fadiga e corrosão.
Observar o uso da Análise de Elementos Finitos (FEA) para componentes do trem de pouso.
Habilidades adquiridas:
Princípios básicos de estresse, tensão e ciência dos materiais
Uso de ferramentas de simulação (por exemplo, FEA)
Aplicação de testes de materiais em engenharia aeronáutica
3. Conformidade Regulatória e Documentação
Tarefas:
Saber mais sobre o papel dos órgãos reguladores (FAA, ANAC, EASA...) nas operações de MRO.
Auxiliar na documentação dos procedimentos de manutenção, inspeção e reparo.
Entender como manter a conformidade com os padrões de aeronavegabilidade.
Habilidades adquiridas:
Familiaridade com normas e certificações regulatórias
Sistemas de gerenciamento e rastreamento de documentação
Atenção aos protocolos de conformidade e aeronavegabilidade
4. Gestão e Coordenação de Projetos
Tarefas:
Acompanhar os gerentes de projeto para entender o agendamento e a alocação de recursos.
Auxiliar no gerenciamento de cronogramas e documentação de projetos para projetos de revisão de trens de pouso.
Ajudar na coordenação entre as equipes de produção, engenharia e qualidade.
Habilidades adquiridas:
Habilidades de gerenciamento de tempo e coordenação de projetos
Compreensão das ferramentas e técnicas de gerenciamento de projetos
Comunicação e colaboração interdepartamental
5. Suporte de campo e interação com o cliente
Tarefas:
Auxiliar na prestação de suporte técnico aos clientes (companhias aéreas, militares, etc.) quando necessário.
Observar as visitas dos clientes e ajude a explicar os processos de reparo.
Participar da análise de causa raiz para problemas recorrentes de trem de pouso.
Habilidades adquiridas:
Habilidades de comunicação com o cliente em um contexto técnico
Resolução de problemas e análise de causa raiz
Coordenação entre engenharia e atendimento ao cliente
Requisitos e informações da vaga:
O candidato deve obrigatoriamente estar cursando nível superior em Engenharia.
A instituição de ensino deve fornecer à empresa um modelo de contrato de estágio.
Duração inicial de 06 meses podendo ser renovado por mais 06 meses com chance de efetivação ao final.
O candidato precisa ter disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma 100% presencial na área industrial do Aeroporto do Galeão - RJ.

title: Azure devops engineer
description:
About you You are a senior-level Dev Ops Engineer who enjoys designing, automating, and operating secure, scalable cloud platforms. You thrive in complex environments where infrastructure reliability, automation, and security are critical. You’re comfortable owning infrastructure decisions end to end and collaborating closely with architects and engineering teams to enable high-performing, cloud-native solutions.
You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of experience in senior or staff-level Dev Ops / Infrastructure Engineering roles. Professional certifications such as Azure Dev Ops, Terraform , or similar (preferred). Hands-on experience with Terraform and automation tools such as env0 (or equivalent). Strong proficiency with Azure services, including networking, Managed Identities, Key Vault, App Services, AKS, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Search, and Azure Open AI. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). Deep expertise in identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta. Advanced skills in CI/CD automation using Git Hub Actions, Azure Dev Ops , and related toolchains. Proficiency in Linux administration and automation scripting using Bash, Power Shell, and/or Python.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights.
Proven track record contributing to or leading complex cloud infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced or large-scale environments.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.
You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:
Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and env0. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security.
Manage Azure networking, databases (SQL, Postgre SQL, Cosmos DB), and identity tools (Entra ID, Okta). Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability.
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions and Azure Dev Ops. Embed best practices for testing, versioning, and automated releases.
Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability.
Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote Dev Ops culture, automation, and continuous improvement.

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.
About Us
Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Master data modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location
Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.
Duties and Responsibilities
Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM Info Sphere Data Architect, SAP Power Designer, or similar tools.
Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.
Desired Qualifications
Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or My SQL.
Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.
Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.
This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.
Role Overview:
As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.
Key Qualifications:
Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.
Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
Extracting and verifying " Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.
Education & Experience:
BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.
Offer Details:
Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
Engagement type: Contractor
Engagement Length: 3 months

title: Estagiário de design
description:

Embora possam existir tarefas ligadas à organização e processos, o foco principal da vaga é o desenvolvimento criativo e a evolução técnica em estamparia.
QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?

Evoluir traços, composições cromáticas e soluções gráficas com consistência estética.

Criar arquivos em Illustrator e Photoshop respeitando as exigências técnicas da estamparia e da indústria têxtil.
Realizar pesquisas visuais e construir repertório autoral relevante para cada briefing.

Atualizar Trello e Miro com status, referências, versões e histórico de evolução das artes.

Preparar arquivos finalizáveis para produção.

Apoiar a equipe em demandas estratégicas do fluxo criativo.

title: Site manager (projetos industriais)
description:
Estamos em busca de um/a Site Manager, que será responsável por gerenciar obras industriais integrando disciplinas, garantindo qualidade, produtividade, conformidade técnica e entrega segura da planta ao cliente. Este/a profissional atuará em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, tendo estas atribuições principais:

Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento e revisão de projetos multidisciplinares industriais (civil, mecânico, elétrico, instrumentação e automação), buscando ganhos de produtividade, padronização de processos construtivos, inovação tecnológica e redução de riscos operacionais e de montagem;
Definir e coordenar a matriz de riscos dos elementos de obras industriais, antecipando falhas potenciais em interfaces disciplinares, riscos de montagem mecânica, riscos de segurança operacional, desvios de performance dos equipamentos e impactos financeiros;
Assegurar a execução com qualidade dos serviços, garantindo conformidade com especificações técnicas, normas internacionais aplicáveis, metodologias executivas específicas que atendam aos requisitos operacionais da planta em construção;
Compatibilizar o projeto com o escopo contratual, analisando a viabilidade das metodologias de montagem, interligações de sistemas e sequenciamento construtivo, otimizando soluções técnicas para reduzir custos, retrabalhos e riscos de parada ou atraso de startup;
Atuar em parceria com Suprimentos na especificação técnica e aquisição de materiais e equipamentos, buscando fornecedores internacionais, garantindo rastreabilidade, conformidade normativa, custo-benefício e gestão eficiente de estoque e entregas;
Aplicar conhecimentos das principais modalidades contratuais utilizadas em obras industriais, desenhando estratégias adequadas para cada contexto e suas interfaces multidisciplinares, mantendo profundo conhecimento do contrato;
Elaborar e sustentar reinvindicações (claims) e aditivos, quando necessário, visando a manutenção do equilíbrio contratual e a proteção dos indicadores de performance do projeto;
Realizar a gestão contratual rigorosa com subcontratados, assegurando cumprimento de obrigações técnicas, regulatórias e de SMS, mitigando passivos e garantindo medições precisas, rastreáveis e conformes ao avanço físico real;
Compreender o desempenho econômico-financeiro de projetos industriais, analisando CAPEX, OPEX, curva S integrada por disciplina, impactos de equipamentos estratégicos e variações cambiais em contratos internacionais.
Manter relacionamento transparente com sindicatos, órgãos reguladores, Corpo de Bombeiros, órgãos ambientais e auditorias técnicas, garantindo observância à legislação trabalhista, NR’s e normas industriais aplicáveis, preservando a segurança empresarial;
Priorizar a Segurança do Trabalho desde as fases de engenharia até a execução, implantando cultura de intolerância a acidentes, gestão de energias perigosas, análises de risco operacionais e práticas avançadas de controle de processo;
Coordenar atividades de pré-comissionamento e completação mecânica, desenvolve planos e procedimentos de comissionamento, manuais de operação e manutenção, matrizes de testes e controles rigorosos de qualidade e riscos operacionais;
Planejar e gerenciar a partida da planta industrial, coordenando testes operacionais, energização de sistemas elétricos, calibração de instrumentos, testes de performance e integração com a equipe de operação, garantindo entrega segura e funcional ao cliente.
Perfil Requerido:
Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Civil, Elétrica, Produção ou correlatas;
Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
Sólida experiência como Site Manager em obras do ramo industrial, sobretudo em plantas químicas e/ou petroquímicas;
Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;
Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:
✔ Transporte e Logística

title: Podcast audio editor
description:

Sofia Health® is an online marketplace that connects clients with providers across a wide range of health and wellness services, offering everything from 1:1 sessions to wellness products. The platform empowers individuals to access both conventional and complementary care in one convenient location, giving them greater choice and control over their health journey. The company also partners with employers and government agencies, including VA Health Care Systems, to deliver accessible, integrative wellness programs. Sofia Health is dedicated to making wellness personalized, effective, and universally accessible.
Role Description
This is a contract remote role for a Podcast Audio Editor. The Podcast Audio Editor will be responsible for editing podcast audio files, enhancing sound quality, implementing sound design, adding music, and ensuring overall quality control for each episode. The role involves working closely with the content team to maintain brand consistency and meet deadlines efficiently.

Edit raw podcast audio into polished, broadcast-ready episodes

Improve pacing, clarity, and flow without changing the speaker’s voice or intent
Restructure sections when needed based on how questions were answered
Insert intro/outro, sponsor reads, disclaimers, or updates when required
Follow embedded audio notes and written instructions carefully
Deliver clean final WAV/MP3 files on deadline
Produce 3–4 short clips per episode for marketing use Support up to two rounds of edits per episode when requested What We’re Looking For
Proven experience editing long-form podcasts (interview or narrative style) Strong editorial judgment — you know what to cut and why Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow instructions precisely
Comfortable working with physician and expert-level conversations
Fast, reliable turnaround times
Clear, professional communication
Familiarity with tools like Descript, Adobe Audition, Pro Tools, Logic, or similar
Qualifications
Proficiency in Audio Editing, including cleaning, trimming, and fine-tuning audio files
Experience with Sound Design and the ability to enhance audio with effects and background elements
Knowledge of Sound and Music production basics to seamlessly incorporate them into content
Strong Editing skills paired with attention to detail to maintain high-quality output
Familiarity with audio editing software such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar tools
Ability to work independently, communicate effectively with teams, and meet deadlines
Experience in podcast production is a plus
Background in audio engineering, media production, or a related field is beneficial

title: Analista de inteligência de negócios sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Acompanhar de forma próxima a performance dos shoppings, com leitura aprofundada dos principais drivers de resultado;
Realizar análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com foco nos indicadores operacionais Identificar, estruturar e priorizar alavancas de resultado, avaliando impacto, viabilidade e retorno financeiro;
Desenvolver análises estratégicas integradas, conectando desempenho financeiro, comercial e operacional dos ativos;
Atuar em parceria com as Regionais e Shoppings, traduzindo análises em direcionamentos táticos claros e acionáveis;
Preparar materiais executivos e apoiar fóruns e apresentações para a Diretoria;
Atuar como referência analítica em performance e resultados, garantindo profundidade, consistência e qualidade das entregas.
Requisitos e qualificações:
Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidada como Analista em áreas estratégicas;
Vivência em análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com leitura crítica de indicadores de resultado;
Domínio de indicadores como: margem, custos, vendas, SSS, rentabilidade e performance operacional;
Experiência na construção de recomendações estratégicas e suporte à tomada de decisão executiva;
Habilidade para traduzir dados complexos em insights claros;
Excel avançado e experiência com ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (ex.: Power BI, similares).

Unidades: Rio de Janeiro | São Paulo | Porto Alegre

Realizar consultas dermatológicas focadas na saúde da pele, cabelo e unhas, identificando patologias e condições estéticas.
Diagnosticar e tratar doenças dermatológicas (acne, melasma, rosácea, dermatites, etc.).
Avaliar e indicar os procedimentos estéticos mais adequados para cada paciente, considerando suas expectativas e características individuais.
Executar procedimentos dermatológicos estéticos como: Aplicação de toxina botulínica e preenchedores. Lasers (depilação, remoção de manchas, rejuvenescimento). Peelings químicos e físicos. Microagulhamento. Bioestimuladores de colágeno. Tratamentos para flacidez e gordura localizada (conforme especialização e equipamentos da clínica).
Acompanhar a evolução dos pacientes pós-procedimentos, garantindo a segurança e os resultados esperados.
Prescrever medicamentos e dermocosméticos, orientando sobre o uso adequado.
Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as últimas tendências, tecnologias e pesquisas na área da dermatologia clínica e estética.
Colaborar com a equipe multidisciplinar da clínica (esteticistas, fisioterapeutas, enfermeiros) para um plano de tratamento integrado.
Participar de treinamentos e reuniões da equipe, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços.
Garantir a ética e a biossegurança em todos os procedimentos e interações com os pacientes.
Requisitos:
Formação completa em Medicina, com residência médica em Dermatologia reconhecida pelo MEC e pela SBD (Sociedade Brasileira de Dermatologia).
Registro ativo no CRM (Conselho Regional de Medicina) e RQE (Registro de Qualificação de Especialista) em Dermatologia.
Experiência comprovada em procedimentos dermatológicos estéticos e tratamentos clínicos.
Conhecimento aprofundado em anatomia facial e corporal.
Diferenciais:
Pós-graduação ou cursos complementares em Dermatologia Estética ou áreas afins.
Experiência com tecnologias específicas utilizadas na clínica (ex: ultrassom microfocado, radiofrequência etc.).
Portfólio de casos de sucesso.

title: Especialista de planejamento tributário
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Acompanhamento e análise de alterações na legislação tributária e consultoria interna;
Atuação estratégica junto a assessores externos na elaboração de pareceres e acompanhamento de fiscalizações;
Atendimento a auditorias e controle de processos tributários;
Estruturação de novas atividades, serviços e novos empreendimentos multiuso, incluindo pesquisa da legislação;
Análise contratual e simulação da alternativa fiscal mais eficiente;
Atuação em projetos de M& A, com foco em reestruturações societárias preparatórias para aquisições e vendas de ativos;
Identificação de oportunidades e condução da implementação de projetos, a fim de garantir a maximização dos resultados e a redução de riscos fiscais.

Experiência sólida na área Tributária;

title: Quantitative project manager (remote)
description:
M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.
Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.
Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.
Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Quantitative Project Manager at M3 Global Research.

About the Business Unit:

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.
M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.
Job Description
The Mission:

The mission of the Quantitative Project Manager is to be a communication and relationship liaison between M3, our clients, and other teams involved in the project’s completion. You will directly manage all aspects of each project on time and within budget. This is the ideal role for someone who has experience in international online market research specifically focused on healthcare, sampling, survey recruitment, and collaboration with all teams involved in the project.
Duties include:

Manage international quantitative market research projects through entire project life cycle including all aspects of managing clients, partners, healthcare professional sample, and consumer sample.
Work directly with various teams to setup and test survey links and redirects, prepare and send sample, conduct quality/audit checks, managing respondent inquiries and honorarium and all other components of online research.
Coordinate and lead project kickoff meetings for all assigned studies to ensure all involved parties understand project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities.
Manage and leverage relationships with vendors to facilitate accurate and timely deliverables, communications, and issue resolution.
Monitor productivity and quality of data collection to produce regular updates and progress reports on project status.
Manage study profitability by monitoring and accounting for all project costs affecting the budget.
Partner with sales team members and operations staff to address issues and/or make recommendations to improve performance on research studies.
Work independently to support international teams outside of normal US business hours. Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
The candidate must have at least 2-3 years’ experience in market research project management, preferably in the medical/healthcare field.
The candidate must be a self-motivated individual with exceptional time management, organizational skills and attention to detail.
The candidate must have well-developed analytical and problem solving skills; ability to quickly solve problems as they present as well as proactively identify and resolve potential issues to avoid escalation. The candidate must have the ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives.
The candidate must have basic math skills and be able to calculate incidence rate, response rate, honoraria amounts, profit, etc.
The candidate must have very strong Microsoft Office skills including Excel, Outlook and Word, and be a quick learner of new technologies/software.
The candidate must have exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
The candidate must have the ability to manage multiple online research projects accurately and on-time in a fast-paced environment where moving deadlines and other changes often occur in real time. Additional Information
*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.Experience
Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.About Us
Innovators in Simulation Technology

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Associate director - Flights Marketing

Get to Know ourTeam:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this role, you’ll getto:
  • Co-own the flights PnL with Product counterparts
  • Define the overall Marketing Strategy for Flights Vertical
  • Execute the strategy: spearhead the development, execution, and optimization for growing Agoda’s Flights business on different channels (e.G., CRM, Paid Peformance marketing, pricing)
  • Guide, coach and manage a team who
  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights
  • Develop hypotheses, design experiments (e.G., A/B tests), and build structured analyses to rigorously evaluate campaign effectiveness and drive data-driven decisions for channel growth
  • Partner closely with various business functions, especially Marketing Accommodation, Flights product and flights supply, to identify opportunities, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using different techniques and tools such as SQL or Tableau to drive meaningful initiatives
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of business initiatives, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Communicate complex findings, performance updates, and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to key stakeholders, including senior management
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of analysts and managers;
    participate in hiring and onboarding new team members.
What you’ll need to succeed:
  • Extensive Experience: 10+ years in Data Analyst position or otherwise in projects involving big data — preferably in the tech, e-commerce, or digital marketing industry. Experience in articulating strategic issues and negotiating with C-level executives – experience in leading strategy consulting projects
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Data-Driven Approach: Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, translate data into actionable insights, and generate impactful recommendations. You really need to love data for this role!
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL
  • Strong Communication Skills: Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (especially Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • People management experience: including hiring, coaching, and developing team members
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership and a get-thing-done attitude.
It’s great if you have:
  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in the online travel or e-commerce industry
  • Experience in flights industry
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

Descrição da vaga

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrófica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

description:

About us:

Grail Talent is an Influencer Management Agency that connects our diverse and carefully curated roster of content creators with digital marketing opportunities, working with brands and record labels to advertise products and music on social media through influencer promotion and performance marketing.

We work with some of the biggest players in Music and New Media, including Sony Music Entertainment and Amazon Prime Video, to help promote the next viral sensation or hit show. In doing so, we are shaping the future of how digital marketing budgets are spent; delivering dynamic and creative promotional campaigns across a variety of social media channels such as TikTok and Instagram, and measuring their impact with detailed analytics.

Job Summary:

As an Influencer Talent Manager, you will be responsible for managing the careers of our creators, helping them grow their audience and monetise their content. Using our in-house software and your own expertise, you will also be responsible for negotiating deals with brands/record labels and developing content strategies for our clients.

What You'll Do:

Manage & Scale Creators: Oversee influencer portfolios and help talent grow their platform presence while securing brand deals.

Talent Acquisition: Scout and sign new creators, focusing on emerging and established influencers.

Foster Brand Relationships: Build and nurture strong partnerships with brands and agencies to book top talent for campaigns.

Strategic Growth: Collaborate with internal teams to shape the overall strategy and expand Grail's talent roster.

Autonomous & Flexible Work: Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while having the flexibility to work independently and remotely.

We don't like to put people in boxes, but if you're likely to be able to demonstrate much of the below then we'll love to hear from you:

Already very familiar with TikTok and what it's all about

Excellent communication and negotiation skills

Ready to hustle to get the job done

The hunger to make quick opportunistic wins, and the patience to work long cycles

Prepared to work flexible hours

Ability to work autonomously and drive your own agenda

Passion for, or ambition to change how things are done

Bonus: Experience with talent management, social media influencers, sales, marketing agencies

Why Join Grail Talent?

Unlimited Earning Potential: Your income directly reflects your performance, with uncapped commission earnings.

Work with Global Brands: Collaborate with top brands like Amazon, Gucci, and Sony Music to execute major influencer marketing campaigns.

Career Growth: Join a growing company with the opportunity to lead and shape the influencer management team.

Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy flexibility with remote work options and the ability to manage your own schedule.

Creative & Collaborative Culture: Work with a dynamic, passionate team that values innovation and creativity.

Ready to Make an Impact?
If you're excited about shaping the careers of Instagram influencers and want to help lead the future of influencer marketing, we'd love to hear from you Please submit your resume along with a cover letter detailing your experience and qualifications.

Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país.
